newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil calls for urgent end to Mideast bloodshed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil calls for urgent end to Mideast bloodshed.

text.p: Brazil expressed concern over fighting between Israeli and Palestinian security forces on Thursday and called for both sides to take urgent measures to end the bloodshed.

"The government of Brazil, where different ethnic and relgious groups live harmoniously, reiterates its appeal that Israelis and Palestinians continue with peace negotiations," the Foreign Relations Ministry said in a statement.
Only the path of talks would lead to "a just, widespread and longlasting peace" in the region and end "the cycle of violence" there, the statement said.
